// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The one legitimate shape for a relation name inside a projection: a direct
// key of _count.select with the value true. It counts rows and names nobody.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function teachersWithClassCounts() {
  return db.teacher.findMany({
    select: {
      id: true,
      email: true,
      _count: { select: { classes: true } },
    },
  });
}
